chunks: My father (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us, he said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, from Ali ibn Hassan al-Wasiti, from his paternal uncle Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir al-Hashimi, from Dawud ibn Kathir al-Riqqi, who said:

I was in the presence of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when he asked for water. When he drank it, I saw that he wept and his eyes brimmed with tears. Then he said: O Dawud, may God curse the killer of al-Husayn! How the remembrance of al-Husayn has embittered life!

Indeed, I have never drunk cold water without remembering al-Husayn, and there is no servant who drinks water and then remembers al-Husayn (peace be upon him) and curses his killer, except that God writes for him a hundred thousand good deeds, erases from him a hundred thousand evil deeds, raises for him a hundred thousand ranks, and it is as though he has freed a hundred thousand souls, and God will gather him on the Day of Resurrection radiant of face.

key_terms.الحسين: Imam Husayn ibn Ali, the grandson of Prophet Muhammad, martyred at Karbala in 680 CE
key_terms.حسنات: Good deeds recorded in one's divine ledger
key_terms.لعن: Invoking God's curse upon oppressors and wrongdoers
key_terms.نسمة: A soul/life; freeing a nasama means manumitting a slave, one of the greatest virtuous acts in Islam

ai.seo_question: What reward does Islam promise for remembering Imam Husayn when drinking water?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) wept while drinking water, remembering the thirst of Imam Husayn (AS) at Karbala. He taught Dawud ibn Kathir that anyone who remembers Husayn and curses his killer when drinking water will receive immense rewards from God: a hundred thousand good deeds recorded, a hundred thousand sins erased, a hundred thousand ranks elevated, the equivalent of freeing a hundred thousand souls, and a radiant face on the Day of Resurrection. This hadith reflects the deep personal grief the Ahl al-Bayt carried for the tragedy of Karbala, and the spiritual practice of remembering Husayn during daily acts like drinking water.
